context_requirements: Active mTORC1 signaling, typically via PI3K/AKT activation (PTEN loss, PIK3CA mutation, HER2 amplification, or receptor tyrosine kinase activation)
Intact FKBP1A/FKBP12 for rapamycin-class allosteric inhibitors
Proliferating cells with mTOR-dependent protein synthesis and G1 progression
Wild-type TP53 for p21-dependent sensitization effects
falsifiers: No decrease in MYC or D-type cyclin (CCND1/CCND3) transcripts at 6-24 h
No increase in DDIT4 or EIF4EBP1 at 6 h
No G1 arrest signature or proliferation_down program at 24 h
Stronger response in PTEN-null lines than in PIK3CA-mutant or HER2-amplified lines

evidence.supports: DEPTOR is an mTOR-interacting inhibitor; mTORC1/2 regulate growth, proliferation and survival, and feedback from mTORC1 to PI3K/Akt shapes signaling output
RAD001/everolimus inhibits mTOR and reduces p53-induced p21 translation, sensitizing wild-type p53 tumor cells to apoptosis
CCI-779 inhibits mTOR and decreases D-type cyclin and c-myc while increasing p27(kip-1); sensitivity correlates with Akt pathway activation
Dual PI3K/mTOR inhibitor NVP-BEZ235 selectively induces apoptosis in HER2-amplified and PIK3CA-mutant breast cancer cells
NVP-BEZ235 inhibits PI3K/Akt/mTOR signaling, causes G1 arrest and autophagy, and decreases VEGF in glioma cells
